title: Lesson
description: A methodological finding. Carries NO numeric field, so there is nothing on it to assign to a calculation input — see CONTRACT.md §2. Observation count lives on the admission record, not the lesson body, precisely so it cannot be mistaken for a tunable.

source_kind.description: The only admissible derivation. CHAT, FETCHED_WEB and MODEL_GENERATED_TEXT are text about text, not evidence about the world.

propertyNames.description: A lesson may not carry a tunable by name either. The type-level guarantee is no numeric field; this is the serialised backstop.
